prompt: This folder has a small command-line tool, ContosoNotes. We're going to ship it as an MSIX. After someone installs it, I want them to be able to just type `contoso-notes` in any terminal to run it. Please set that up, install it on this machine, and check that `contoso-notes --version` works from a new terminal.
checks: installed (required): a new package whose application is ContosoNotes.exe is installed
alias-declared (required): the installed manifest declares the execution alias contoso-notes.exe
alias-runs (required): `contoso-notes --version` in a new process prints 'ContosoNotes 1.2.0'
